paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Financial Analyst, AWS Competitive Intelligence role in Seattle. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Cloud and AI infrastructure is the market I most want to work in, and a role built around explaining what competitors are doing, what is known and what is estimated, is a good fit for how I like to work.

At JPMorgan Asset Management I benchmarked historical marketing-channel budget allocations against peers, finding 30% efficiency gains, and prepared executive-level briefs that pulled together financial analysis and sector trends for senior leadership. In my MBA coursework I analyzed financial statements and disclosures to assess earnings quality across firms, and valued J.M. Smucker using comps and a DCF.
That maps to reading competitors' financials closely, separating facts from estimates, and writing short narratives that help AWS leaders decide what to do. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli and I'm applying for the Senior Financial Analyst, AWS Competitive Intelligence role. At JPMorgan Asset Management I benchmarked budget allocations against peers to find 30% efficiency gains and wrote executive briefs on sector trends for senior leadership. I'd like to hear how the team builds its competitive views. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
